label: magic chalk
description: A stub of chalk, warm in the hand, that never seems to wear down. Wherever she draws with it, a line of pale light stays behind in the stone.

label: chalk drawing
description: A tangle of geometric lines chalked into the floor — angles and arcs that almost make sense, like a diagram of something that isn't finished.

label: iron chisel
description: A miner's chisel with a worn leather grip. It bites into stone like it remembers being made for it.

label: herb salve
description: A fragrant green paste in a clay pot. Village herbalists swear it knits wounds closed.

label: warden core
description: The heart of the Warden, a fist-sized stone still warm. While you carry it, the other golems bow to your will.
